nodes.name: Arbiter of Grace
nodes.description: While Vow of Grace is active, your Glorious Execution now regenerates an additional 15% mana equal to the damage dealt.

nodes.name: Judgement of the Valkyrie
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Judgement Day by -15 sec.

nodes.name: Leap of the Valkyrie
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sun Stride by -4 sec.

nodes.name: Herald of Purity
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Justice now has an 8% chance to reset its own cooldown.

nodes.name: Trial of Valor
nodes.description: Fulfilling a Vow now reduces the cooldown of Horusath Blast by -2 sec.

nodes.name: Blessed Hammer
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Solar Invocation spells by -10 sec.

nodes.name: Valkyr's Calling
nodes.description: Target an enemy and leap into the air, becoming immune to all physical attacks and spells for 2 seconds. At the end of the duration, you charge back down, dealing 428 + 100% AP + 22.5% SP Holy damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

nodes.name: March of the Valkyr
nodes.description: Increases the all damage dealt by party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.In addition, your chance to parry is increased by 5%.

nodes.name: Sunwalker
nodes.description: Dealing melee damage now generates a stack of Sunwalker.SunwalkerReduces the cast time and mana cost of your next Shine by -20% for 30 seconds, stacking 5 times.

nodes.name: Vow of the Valkyr
nodes.description: Auto attacks generate 1 Solar Power and deal 10% increased damage.Fulfillment: Melee ability damage triggers an auto attack with each weapon.Only 1 Vow can be active at a time.

nodes.name: Blessed Magic
nodes.description: Casting Horusath Blast now resets the cooldown of Glorious Execution.

nodes.name: Last Call
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Valkyr's Calling by 1 sec.

nodes.name: By The Light
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Valkyr's Calling by 50%.

nodes.name: Vindicator
nodes.description: Your Glorious Execution now ignores -10% of the target's armor while Vow of the Valkyr is active.

nodes.name: Radiant Power
nodes.description: Each stack of Sunwalker now increases the critical strike chance of Shine by 3%.

nodes.name: Pendant of the Sun
nodes.description: Activate your pendant of the sun, refreshing the duration and all charges of Dawn.

nodes.name: Radiant Halberd
nodes.description: Direct Physical damage dealt now reduces the cooldown of Champion of the Sun by -1 sec.

nodes.name: Solar Empowerment
nodes.description: Fulfilling your Vow now unleashes a chain of light at your target, dealing 91 + 23% holy SP + 10% AP Holy damage and then bouncing to up to 5 additional enemies, dealing reduced damage with each strike.

nodes.name: Holy Giant
nodes.description: Level 50 PassiveDoubles the effectiveness of Vow of the Valkyr.

nodes.name: Light's Blessing
nodes.description: Casting Sunslam now reduces the cooldown of Pendant of the Sun by -10 sec.

nodes.name: Knight of Dawn
nodes.description: Your Glorious Execution now has a 20% chance to strike 1 additional time.

nodes.name: Divine Retribution
nodes.description: Accumulates 25% of your damage dealt to on the target and unleashes it after 8 seconds, damaging enemies within 10 yds as Holy damage.
